checks.check: The agent reads the describe/status reason and logs before guessing, and notices the error occurs at the WRITE stage, not as a generic transform crash.
The agent identifies the root cause as the embedding attribute being declared string() instead of a vector type, so the column was provisioned as TEXT rather than vector.
The agent fixes the semantic model to use vector_embeddings(<dim>) with the dimension the embedding model emits (e.g. 384 for all-MiniLM-L6-v2).
The agent states the table must be re-provisioned / re-launched for the column type to change, and does NOT merely re-run the transform against the wrong column.
The agent does NOT misattribute the failure to credentials, memory, or API/parsing problems.
